title: Bitcoin Spot ETF Officially Approved by SEC
summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission has approved the first spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds in the US, a landmark decision for the crypto industry.

expected.key_takeaway: SEC approves first spot Bitcoin ETFs, opening floodgates for institutional capital into BTC.

title: Major Crypto Exchange XYZ Hacked for $100M
summary: Hackers exploited a vulnerability in exchange XYZ's hot wallet, draining over $100 million in various altcoins.

expected.key_takeaway: Exchange XYZ loses $100M in hot wallet exploit, raising security concerns for centralized platforms.

title: Solana Network Experiences 4-Hour Downtime
summary: The Solana blockchain stopped producing blocks for 4 hours due to a consensus bug, requiring a network restart.

expected.key_takeaway: Solana network restart required after 4-hour consensus bug outage.
